import json
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
data=[]
def add(calls,pre,unmarked=None,low=None,note=''):
 i=len(data); x=items[i]; assert len(calls)==x['slots'],(i+1,calls)
 data.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(j+1):c for j,c in enumerate(calls)},confidence={str(j+1):('low' if low and j+1 in low else 'high') for j in range(len(calls))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=unmarked or [],pre1918=pre,note=note))
def save():
 with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
  for x in data:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
add('ъъ','yes')
add('ьъъ','yes')
add('ь','no')
add('ъъь','yes')
add('ь','no')
add('ььъ','yes')
add('ь','no')
add('ь','no')
save()

import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(items)==len(answers)
c=collections.Counter()
for item,answer in zip(items,answers):
 assert item['item_id']==answer['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,item['slots']+1)}
 assert set(answer['slots'])==expected
 assert set(answer['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(x in {'ъ','ь','other','u'} for x in answer['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in {'high','low'} for x in answer['confidence'].values())
 assert answer['pre1918'] in {'yes','no','unclear'}
 assert isinstance(answer['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
 c.update(answer['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items')
print('Slot calls:',{k:c[k] for k in ['ъ','ь','other','u']})
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
PY
